name: Puzzle Gate
disable: DC 44 Athletics check (master) to force-open the gate, DC 41 Crafting check or DC 41 Thievery check (expert) twice to dismantle the puzzle lock, or DC 34 Games Lore check (expert) or DC 36 Society check (expert) five times to solve the puzzles
reset: The hazard resets after 1 minute if even one puzzle remains unsolved. The hazard doesn't reset if the gate is destroyed.
routine: The puzzle makes an electroshock Strike against two different creatures.

items.name: Defense Activated
items.text:
Trigger A creature damages the gate or fails to bypass the gate by any other means other than a Games Lore or Society check

---
Effect The hazard makes an electroshock Strike against the triggering creature. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: This complicated lock requires solving five puzzles in quick succession.
